Threaded userSettings through getProtonSignature/templateBuilder/insertSignature/changeSignature/textToHtml/plainTextToHTML/generateBlockquote/createNewDraft and the composer components, added eoDefaultUserSettings; tsc clean, full mail jest suite green (73 suites, 567 tests, 32 snapshots unchanged), and a scratch feature test failed 7/9 at base and passed 9/9 after.

All 8 requirements implemented and individually spot-checked; live playbook repro shows workers move from shared session + inherited stdout to own session with fds 0/1/2 on /dev/null; full unit suite delta vs base is -2 failures, 0 new.

Added User.getIconBackgrounds (plugin-filterable palette) plus the plumbing that makes a stored icon:bgColor win over the username hash; verified with a db-stubbed probe that fails at base and passes after, and eslint delta is zero, but the real mocha suite needs a database so it was not run.

All 8 requirements met: new DeviceMetaData component + isDeviceVerified helper, DeviceTile/DevicesPanel/useOwnDevices delegate to them, toast reworded and embeds DeviceMetaData; tsc delta 0 new errors, full jest suite delta 0 new failures (356 snapshots unchanged), eslint/prettier clean, 8 throwaway behavioural asserts on the toast passed.

Deleted CacheUnaryInterceptor + its wiring in internal/cmd/grpc.go and moved flag caching into the storage/cache decorator (s:f:<ns>:<key>, protobuf) with invalidation on Update/DeleteFlag and Create/Update/DeleteVariant, plus setJSON/getJSON/setProtobuf/getProtobuf helpers; evaluation-response caching (ev1/ev2 keys) is dropped rather than relocated since it is not a storage operation, and Store still satisfies storage.Store by embedding rather than 40 hand-written delegations. go build ./... clean, gofmt/go vet clean, focused packages green, and the only ./internal/... failures (redis, gitfs) are identical at base.

Added OperationProgressTracker (main) + wired it through MainInterface/WorkerClient/WorkerLocator, switched CalendarFacade._saveCalendarEvents to an onProgress callback and saveImportedCalendarEvents to an operationId, and made the import dialog show the per-operation progress; tsc clean on src and test, calendar test suites green (618 assertions) incl. a new test proving 10->100 reaches the tracker, but the repo's full `node test` build is red at base on Node 22 (better-sqlite3 node-gyp).

Added touchid.Registration (CCR/credentialID/done) with atomic Confirm/Rollback, DeleteNonInteractive across nativeTID + darwin cgo/objc + noop, Register now returns *Registration, and tsh mfa add confirms on ack / rolls back otherwise; go vet + gofmt clean, touchid tests pass and the two new subtests were negative-controlled.

Added auth.U2FAuthenticateChallenge (embeds legacy *u2f.AuthenticateChallenge, adds Challenges list), made U2FSignRequest issue one challenge per registered U2F device, propagated the type through ServerWithRoles/Client/IdentityService/sessionCache, made tsh's SSHAgentU2FLogin pass every challenge (falling back to the embedded one from older proxies), hid `tsh mfa`; repaired the base-red harness (vendored reflect2 v1.0.1 segfaults on go1.24, webassets submodule absent) and confirmed 0 new failures in lib/auth and lib/web plus a passing WebSuite.TestU2FLogin as backward-compat proof.

incdec_number now reads/writes segments FullyEncoded+StrictMode via a module-level _URL_SEGMENTS table, skips digits inside percent triplets via (?<!%)(?<!%.), and rejects decrement when count > value; repro of all three bugs verified before/after, tests/unit delta 0 new failures (321 pre-existing both sides) with 9 net-new passing tests, flake8 clean; two judgement calls flagged: default segments narrowed to {'path'} per the requirements list (base was {'path','query'}), and 'port' kept selectable since the base test test_incdec_port pins it and a sibling requirement says the structure must cover port.
